# AutoCAD dynamic block fixtures

`point.dwg`, `xy.dwg`, `polar.dwg` and `lookup.dwg` are drawings made in
AutoCAD with dynamic blocks: a point parameter with a move action, an XY
parameter with an array action, two polar parameters with polar stretch
actions, and a linear parameter with a stretch action, a point parameter with
a move action and two lookup parameters sharing a lookup table. Each has
references whose values differ from the defaults.

They come from acadrust's test fixtures (`tests/fixtures/dynamic-blocks`),
made by Albert Domenech and published under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.
